BAKHTIAR PROSPECTS
document_only.source_excerpt: THE RAMSEY CLARK STATEMENT CALLING ON THE USG TO DROP ITS SUPPORT FOR THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT (WIDELY CARRIED IN THE PRESS) CORRECTLY OR NOT IS BEING INTERPRETED AS EVIDENT OR EVENTUAL U.S. POLICY. document_only.subject: STATUS OF AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI
document_only.source_excerpt: AFTER HAVING SENT US A NOTE JANUARY 18 STATING THAT AMBASSADOR HAD RESIGNED AND HIS RESIGNATION ACCEPTED BY FOREIGN MINISTRY, IRANIAN EMBASSY (HOMAYOUN) TELEPHONED URGENTLY THIS MORNING TO SAY THAT PRIME MINISTER HAD TOLD HIM THAT ZAHEDI'S RESIGNATION WAS NOT REPEAT NOT ACCEPTED. HOMAYOUN UNDERSTOOD THAT ZAHEDI WOULD BE RETAINED AS AMBASSADOR FOR AT LEAST ONE MONTH.

document_only.subject: STATUS OF AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI
document_only.source_excerpt: WHEN MILITARY LEADERS HEARD THAT IRANIAN EMBASSY WAS TO BE CONTROLLED BY ANTI-SHAH GROUP, THEY BECAME CONCERNED OVER THE INTEGRITY OF THE FILES AND PREVAILED UPON PRIMIN BAKHTIAR NOT TO ACCEPT ZAHEDI'S RESIGNATION AT THIS TIME.

document_only.subject: COUP IN SEYCHELLES
document_only.source_excerpt: FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY CALLED DCM JUNE 9 TO SAY THAT WHEN THE NEW PRC AMBASSADOR PRESENTED HIS CREDENTIALS TO THE SHAH THAT MORNING HE CLAIMED THAT IT WAS HIS AND HIS GOVERNMENTS VIEW THAT THE COUP IN THE SEYCHELLES WAS SOVIET INSPIRED AND BACKED. KHALATBARY SAID THAT, OF COURSE, BLAMING THE SOVIETS FOR ANYTHING THAT THEY DID NOT LIKE WAS PART OF THE STANDARD PRC LINE BUT THOUGHT WE WOULD LIKE TO KNOW THAT IT CAME UP ANYHOW. HE ADDED THAT THE SHAH HAD NOT EXPRESSED ANY OPINION.

document_only.subject: BIJAN AMINI
document_only.source_excerpt: DEPTOFF MET JANUARY 3 WITH BIJAN AMINI, NEPHEW OF ALI AMINI AND REPRESENTATIVE OF SEVERAL AMERICAN FIRMS IN IRAN. HIS PRESENTATION DID NOT DIFFER FROM THE PESSIMISTIC VIEW OF MOST OF OUR VISITORS. THE SHAH MUST GO AND GO QUICKLY. A MILITARY COUP WOULD BE A DISASTER. THERE WAS LITTLE HOPE THAT BAKHTIAR WOULD BE SUCCESSFUL. AND SO FORTH.

document_only.subject: NATHANSON'S INITIATIVE
document_only.source_excerpt: MR. ANNOSHIRAVAN BATMANGEHLIDJ, AN ASSOCIATE OF GEORGE NATHANSON, VISITED NEA/IRN AT HIS REQUEST. WHILE HIS ENGLISH IS QUITE GOOD, THE SAME CANNOT BE SAID ABOUT THE CLARITY OF HIS THINKING, AT LEAST ON THE BASIS OF HIS DISCUSSION WITH DEPOFF. HE RAMBLED A GREAT DEAL, USING STRANGE JARGON AND VAGUE STATEMENTS. THE GIST OF WHAT HE TRIED TO CONVEY SEEMED TO BE THAT HE AND HIS ASSOCIATES WANTED TO EMBARK ON A PUBLIC RELATIONS CAMPAIGN TO SAVE THE COUNTRY. THEY WOULD GET THE MONEY FOR IT FROM THE COURT VIA GENERAL FARDUST, BUT WANTED TO LAUNCH A CAMPAIGN UNDER THE DIRECTION AND GUIDANCE OF THE U.S. GOVERNMENT.

document_only.subject: SHIFT IN ONE IRANIAN'S MOOD TOWARD RETENTION OF SHAH
document_only.source_excerpt: HE FEELS THAT THE DANGER OF A COALITION GOVERNMENT IS THAT PEOPLE LIKE SANJABI NOT HAVE THE COURAGE TO SAY NO TO THE PEOPLE BUT WILL BE LED BY THE RABBLE RATHER THAN THE OTHER WAY AROUND. CONSEQUENTLY, FAELI DOUBTS THAT THE SHAH WOULD LONG SURVIVE, EVEN AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH, ONCE A COALITION IS IN PLACE. HOWEVER, THE UNCERTAINTY WHICH IS LIKELY TO ACCOMPANY THIS SORT OF WEAK GOVERNMENT MAY WELL LEAD, IN FAELI'S VIEW TO A MILITARY COUP. WHILE SUCH A COUP COULD INITIALLY PRESERVE THE SHAH, FAELI ASSUMES THAT "SOME COLONEL" WOULD SOON REPLACE THE GENERAL(S) WHO LED THE ORIGINAL PUTSCH, WITH UNPREDICTABLE RESULTS.

document_only.subject: (C)RELIGIOUS MODERATES AIMING TO LEAN ON KHOMEINI
document_only.source_excerpt: MINATCHI WAS CONFIDENT THAT KHOMEINI WOULD NOT OFFER "FINAL SOLUTIONS" TO COUNTRY'S PROBLEMS NOR PROVOKE MILITARY TO REACTION. POLOFF SAID OUR VIEW WAS THAT, IF HE ANNOUNCED RIVAL GOVERNMENT ON ARRIVAL, MILITARY MIGHT MOVE AGAINST HIM. MINATCHI SAID ALL HIS IN-COUNTRY FOLLOWERS UNDERSTOOD THIS AND WERE PRESSING HIM NOT TO PUSH MATTERS TO DISASTER.

passages.subject: COUP IN SEYCHELLES
passages.text: FOREIGN MINISTER KHALATBARY CALLED DCM JUNE 9 TO SAY THAT WHEN THE NEW PRC AMBASSADOR PRESENTED HIS CREDENTIALS TO THE SHAH THAT MORNING HE CLAIMED THAT IT WAS HIS AND HIS GOVERNMENTS VIEW THAT THE COUP IN THE SEYCHELLES WAS SOVIET INSPIRED AND BACKED. KHALATBARY SAID THAT, OF COURSE, BLAMING THE SOVIETS FOR ANYTHING THAT THEY DID NOT LIKE WAS PART OF THE STANDARD PRC LINE BUT THOUGHT WE WOULD LIKE TO KNOW THAT IT CAME UP ANYHOW. HE ADDED THAT THE SHAH HAD NOT EXPRESSED ANY OPINION.

passages.subject: STATUS OF AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI
passages.text: AFTER HAVING SENT US A NOTE JANUARY 18 STATING THAT AMBASSADOR HAD RESIGNED AND HIS RESIGNATION ACCEPTED BY FOREIGN MINISTRY, IRANIAN EMBASSY (HOMAYOUN) TELEPHONED URGENTLY THIS MORNING TO SAY THAT PRIME MINISTER HAD TOLD HIM THAT ZAHEDI'S RESIGNATION WAS NOT REPEAT NOT ACCEPTED. HOMAYOUN UNDERSTOOD THAT ZAHEDI WOULD BE RETAINED AS AMBASSADOR FOR AT LEAST ONE MONTH.

passages.subject: LMI WANTS U.S. TO PUSH; CONFLICT WITH MODERATES SHAPING UP
passages.text: COMMENT AND ANALYSIS: SITUATION IS TAKING ON RITUAL ELEMENTS: KHOMEINI IS PUSHING, HIS IN-COUNTRY ALLIES (LMI) ARE WORRIED ABOUT THE CONSEQUENCES AND TRYING TO MAKE A DEAL, AND LOTS OF HINTS ARE BEING MADE THAT USG SHOULD CARRY THE BALL FOR BOTH SIDES. PERSIAN PENCHANT FOR PUTTING OFF SERIOUS COMPROMISE BETWEEN ONRUSHING OPPONENTS UNTIL THE LAST HOUR IS TURNING POLITICAL ARENA INTO ONE VAST GAME OF "CHICKEN." THIS DOES NOT HAVE STABILIZING EFFECT ON PARTICIPANTS WHEN DONE REPEATEDLY (NOV 5, MOHARRAM, ASHURA, ARBAEIN, AND NOW). MILITARY IS FACED WITH STRIKE OF SENIOR WARRANT OFFICERS (HOMOFARS) IN ISFAHAN, HAMEDAN, DEZFUL, AND MASHAD, ACCORDING TO ENTEZAM.

passages.text: DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE THROUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY. THEY WERE GENERALLY PEACEFUL AND IN FACT CONCENTRATED UPON WINNING OVER THE TROOPS. IN ONE LOCATION AFTER ANOTHER, CROWDS WALKED UP TO TROOPS, SHOUTING "SOLDIERS ARE OUR BROTHERS". THEY PLACED FLOWERS IN GUN MUZZLES AND CALLED FOR THE TROOPS TO JOIN THE CHANTING. TO SOME EXTENT THEY SUCCEEDED. SOLDIERS PERMITTED MULLAHS TO CLIMB ON THEIR VEHICLES TO LEAD ANTI-SHAH CHEERS, WHILE OTHER TROOPS ACCEPTED PICTURES OF KHOMEINI, AND SOME EVEN RODE ON THE SHOULDERS OF THE CROWD. WHILE MANY OR MOST SOLDIERS MAY HAVE REFUSED THIS FRATERNIZATION, LOCAL PRESS IS HAVING A FIELD DAY WITH THOSE WHO WENT ALONG.

atom_assessments.text: The military accepted a deal with Khomeini

citations.text: AFTER HAVING SENT US A NOTE JANUARY 18 STATING THAT AMBASSADOR HAD RESIGNED AND HIS RESIGNATION ACCEPTED BY FOREIGN MINISTRY, IRANIAN EMBASSY (HOMAYOUN) TELEPHONED URGENTLY THIS MORNING TO SAY THAT PRIME MINISTER HAD TOLD HIM THAT ZAHEDI'S RESIGNATION WAS NOT REPEAT NOT ACCEPTED. HOMAYOUN UNDERSTOOD THAT ZAHEDI WOULD BE RETAINED AS AMBASSADOR FOR AT LEAST ONE MONTH.

COMMENT AND ANALYSIS: SITUATION IS TAKING ON RITUAL ELEMENTS: KHOMEINI IS PUSHING, HIS IN-COUNTRY ALLIES (LMI) ARE WORRIED ABOUT THE CONSEQUENCES AND TRYING TO MAKE A DEAL, AND LOTS OF HINTS ARE BEING MADE THAT USG SHOULD CARRY THE BALL FOR BOTH SIDES. PERSIAN PENCHANT FOR PUTTING OFF SERIOUS COMPROMISE BETWEEN ONRUSHING OPPONENTS UNTIL THE LAST HOUR IS TURNING POLITICAL ARENA INTO ONE VAST GAME OF "CHICKEN." THIS DOES NOT HAVE STABILIZING EFFECT ON PARTICIPANTS WHEN DONE REPEATEDLY (NOV 5, MOHARRAM, ASHURA, ARBAEIN, AND NOW). MILITARY IS FACED WITH STRIKE OF SENIOR WARRANT OFFICERS (HOMOFARS) IN ISFAHAN, HAMEDAN, DEZFUL, AND MASHAD, ACCORDING TO ENTEZAM.

DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE THROUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY. THEY WERE GENERALLY PEACEFUL AND IN FACT CONCENTRATED UPON WINNING OVER THE TROOPS. IN ONE LOCATION AFTER ANOTHER, CROWDS WALKED UP TO TROOPS, SHOUTING "SOLDIERS ARE OUR BROTHERS". THEY PLACED FLOWERS IN GUN MUZZLES AND CALLED FOR THE TROOPS TO JOIN THE CHANTING. TO SOME EXTENT THEY SUCCEEDED. SOLDIERS PERMITTED MULLAHS TO CLIMB ON THEIR VEHICLES TO LEAD ANTI-SHAH CHEERS, WHILE OTHER TROOPS ACCEPTED PICTURES OF KHOMEINI, AND SOME EVEN RODE ON THE SHOULDERS OF THE CROWD. WHILE MANY OR MOST SOLDIERS MAY HAVE REFUSED THIS FRATERNIZATION, LOCAL PRESS IS HAVING A FIELD DAY WITH THOSE WHO WENT ALONG.

atom_assessments.text: The military would defend state installations from a rival government

citations.text: MINATCHI WAS CONFIDENT THAT KHOMEINI WOULD NOT OFFER "FINAL SOLUTIONS" TO COUNTRY'S PROBLEMS NOR PROVOKE MILITARY TO REACTION. POLOFF SAID OUR VIEW WAS THAT, IF HE ANNOUNCED RIVAL GOVERNMENT ON ARRIVAL, MILITARY MIGHT MOVE AGAINST HIM. MINATCHI SAID ALL HIS IN-COUNTRY FOLLOWERS UNDERSTOOD THIS AND WERE PRESSING HIM NOT TO PUSH MATTERS TO DISASTER.

AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI ISSUED COMMUNIQUE YESTERDAY, WARNING OF AN OUTSIDE PLOT BY VESTED INTERESTS WHICH TRIES TO SET THE PEOPLE AND THE ARMY AGAINST EACH OTHER. MERCENARIES ARE ATTACKING TROOPS AND GOVERNMENT INSTALLATIONS TO MAKE ARMY THINK THAT THE PEOPLE WISH TO DESTROY THEM. "THE PUBLIC IS DUTY BOUND TO TREAT MEMBERS OF THE SECURITY AND ARMED FORCES WITH BROTHERLY KINDNESS AND TO DEFEND THEM AGAINST ANY POSSIBLE ATTACK BY THE HOOLIGANS.

SUMMARY: LMI'S ENTEZAM TOLD EMBOFF THAT LMI URGENTLY WANTS MEETING WITH SENIOR MILITARY OFFICERS TO ARRANGE FOR PEACEFUL ARRIVAL OF KHOMEINI. LMI WANTS U.S. TO PUSH PRIME MINISTER, MAJLES, AND REGENCY COUNCIL TO RESIGN. POLOFF STATED SUCCINCTLY THAT THIS WAS NOT RPT NOT SOMETING U.S. COULD DO AND EVEN ATTEMPTING IT WOULD UNDOUBTEDLY BE HARMFUL. COMPROMISE ON BOTH SIDES SEEMS NECESSARY. KHOMEINI ATTEMPT TO SET UP RIVAL GOVERNMENT ON HIS RETURN COULD BE VERY DANGEROUS. SOURCE SAID LMI STILL WISHED TO DISCUSS U.S. INTERESTS IN IRAN TO AVOID FUTURE CONFLICT. MEANWHILE, MODERATE RELIGIOUS SOURCE INDICATE OPPOSITION MEETING WITH MILITARY WAS CRITICAL, AND OBLIQUELY CONFIRMED REPORTS OF RIFT WITHIN RELIGIOUS LEADERSHIP.

atom_assessments.text: The military would not launch its own coup

citations.text: MORNING PRESS FEATURES STORIES THAT SHAH HAS TOLD MILITARY LEADERS TO STAY LOYAL TO BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, DECLARING THAT A MILITARY COUP IS OUT OF THE QUESTION. JOURNALS ALSO REPORT RECENT STATEMENTS BY SECRETARY VANCE AND HODDING CARTER, AND THEY DESCRIBE VISIT OF GENERAL HUYSER AS EFFORT TO ENCOURAGE COOPERATION ON THE MILITARY SIDE.

HE FEELS THAT THE DANGER OF A COALITION GOVERNMENT IS THAT PEOPLE LIKE SANJABI NOT HAVE THE COURAGE TO SAY NO TO THE PEOPLE BUT WILL BE LED BY THE RABBLE RATHER THAN THE OTHER WAY AROUND. CONSEQUENTLY, FAELI DOUBTS THAT THE SHAH WOULD LONG SURVIVE, EVEN AS A CONSTITUTIONAL MONARCH, ONCE A COALITION IS IN PLACE. HOWEVER, THE UNCERTAINTY WHICH IS LIKELY TO ACCOMPANY THIS SORT OF WEAK GOVERNMENT MAY WELL LEAD, IN FAELI'S VIEW TO A MILITARY COUP. WHILE SUCH A COUP COULD INITIALLY PRESERVE THE SHAH, FAELI ASSUMES THAT "SOME COLONEL" WOULD SOON REPLACE THE GENERAL(S) WHO LED THE ORIGINAL PUTSCH, WITH UNPREDICTABLE RESULTS.

GOVT DID NOT SEEM READY TO SURRENDER, NOR WOULD MILITARY LET IT GO EVEN IF IT DID. ATTEMPT BY KHOMEINI TO SET UP RIVAL GOVT UPON HIS ARRIVAL COULD BE VERY DANGEROUS. ENTEZAM GULPED A BIT AND ASKED IF THIS MEANT POSSIBILITY OF COUP. EMBOFF REPLIED THAT POSSIBILITY HAD NOT RPT NOT BEEN WHOLLY ABSENT FROM SCENE AT ANY TIME IN RECENT PAST. NO ONE, NOT MILITARY, NOR USG, NOR OPPOSITION REALLY WANTED EVENTS TO COME TO THIS.

document_only.source_excerpt: MAY 19 WASHINGTON POST CARRIES JONATHAN RANDAL ARTICLE DATELINED TEHRAN THAT IRAN HAS TOLD PAKISTAN FURTHER ECONOMIC AID DEPENDS ON SPARING BHUTTO'S LIFE. passages.subject: SOVIET POLICY IN THE HORN: A FRENCH VIEW
passages.text: ON FEBRUARY 9 FRENCH EMBASSY ASSISTANT MILITARY ATTACHE, WHO IS A PERSONAL FRIEND OF POLCOUNS, PRODUCED A VIEW OF SOVIET POLICY IN THE HORN WHICH HAS SOME STRIKING SIMILARITIES TO THAT OF MFA SECRETARY GENERAL SOUTOU (REFTEL). IN PARTICULAR, HE NOTED SOVIETS COMPLETELY REORGANIZED SOMALI INTELLIGENCESECURITY APPARATUS A FEW YEARS BACK AND ARE BOUND TO HAVE MANY ASSETS IN PLACE TODAY, ONLY A FEW MONTHS AFTER SOMALI BREAK WITH THE SOVIETS. MOST LIKELY SOVIET OBJECTIVE, THEREFORE, IS NOT TAKEOVER OF SOMALIA BY ETHIOPIA, BUT RATHER REPLACEMENT OF SIAD BARRE BY SOMEONE PREPARED TO SEE RETURN OF THE SOVIETS TO SOMALIA. THEN SOVIETS WILL HAVE GAINED ETHIOPIA WHILE RETAINING SOMALIA.

passages.subject: IRAN-PAKISTAN RELATIONS
passages.text: MAY 19 WASHINGTON POST CARRIES JONATHAN RANDAL ARTICLE DATELINED TEHRAN THAT IRAN HAS TOLD PAKISTAN FURTHER ECONOMIC AID DEPENDS ON SPARING BHUTTO'S LIFE. STORY ADDS THAT GOI BELIEVES THAT IF BHUTTO IS EXECUTED, PAKISTAN "COULD BE RIPE FOR SOVIET-SPONSORED DESTABILIZATION". QUOTING "INFORMED GOVERNMENT SOURCES" RANDAL ADDS THAT IRAN WAS READY TO USE "ANY MEANS" TO STOP AFGHAN TROUBLEMAKING IN THE AREA, AND THAT SHAH HAS SAID HE WOULD NOT TOLERATE DISINTEGRATION OF PAKISTAN. REMAINDER OF STORY ECHOES FAMILIAR IRANIAN THEME OF SOVIET PLANS TO ENCIRCLE IRAN AND ENDANGER OIL SUPPLIES FROM THE GULF.

passages.subject: AN ELDERLY SHAH LOYALIST CONGRATULATES USG ON ITS POLICY -- AND PRESSES FOR SHAH\'S ABDICATION
passages.text: LIKE MOST OTHER THINKING IRANIANS, KHAJENURI HAS REACHED THE CONCLUSION THAT KNOMEINI IS UNSTOPPABLE. THE SOONER ADEQUATE ACCOMMODATION IS MADE WITH WHAT KHOMEINI REPRESENTS, THE SOONER WILL IRAN MOVE TO A NEW NORMALITY, AND PREVENT A FURTHER SLIDE INTO CHAOS FROM WHICH ONLY THE COMMUNISTS CAN PROFIT. passages.text: WHILE WE REALIZE THIS LAST POINT IS VERY SENSITIVE TO THOSE CONSTITUTIONALISTS WHO WISH TO ESTABLISH DEMOCRATIC CONTROLS, WE BELIEVE THE ARMED FORCES WILL TAKE ORDER ONLY FROM THE SHAH. passages.subject: NEW SWEDISH AMBASSADOR ACCREDITED TO IRAN
passages.text: KAJ INGEMAR SUNDBERG, RECENTLY APPOINTED SWEDISH AMBASSADOR TO IRAN, ARRIVED IN NEW YORK AS DEPUTY PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE TO THE UNITED NATIONS IN 1970. FROM 1965 TO 1970, AMBASSADOR SUNDBERG SERVED IN THE MFA AS COUNSELLOR IN CHARGE OF UN AFFAIRS AND DISARMAMENT ISSUES. HE JOINED THE FOREIGN SERVICE IN 1948 AND WAS ASSIGNED TO THE EMBASSY IN HELSINKI (1949 TO 1951) AND AT THE CONSULATE IN BOMBAY (1952 TO 1954). UNTIL 1961 HE WAS ASSIGNED IN THE MFA POLITICAL SECTION. FROM 1961 TO 1964 HE WAS FIRST SECRETARY AND LATER COMMERCIAL COUNSELLOR AT THE EMBASSY IN WASHINGTON, D.C.

passages.text: FIRST MENTIONED FIVE MONTHS AGO, KHOSROW AKMAL'S APPOINTMENT AS GOI AMBASSADOR TO AUSTRALIA, WITH ACCREDITION TO NEW ZEALAND, HAS FINALLY BEEN ANNOUNCED OFFICIALLY. AKMAL, 43, MOST RECENTLY HELD THE SENIOR DEPUTY POSITION IN THE MINISTRY OF COURT, UNDER HIS FATHER-IN-LAW HORMOZ GHARIB, FORMER GRAND MASTER OF CEREMONIES WHO HIMSELF WAS RECENTLY APPOINTED AMBASSADOR TO ITALY. AKMAL, WHO HAS A DOCTORATE IN LAW FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN, JOINED THE MFA IN 1958 AND SERVED IN THE PASSPORT, EASTERN EUROPE, AND PROTOCOL DIVISIONS. HE ALSO SERVED ABROAD IN BERN AND WAS COUNSELOR FOR CONSULAR AFFAIRS IN WASHINGTON UNTIL THE ARRIVAL OF AMBASSADOR ZAHEDI WHO HAD HIM TRANSFERRED BACK TO TEHRAN.

passages.text: CORRUPTION: THE SHAH SAID THAT MUCH OF THE TALK OF CORRUPTION AND BRIBERY IS A RESULT OF RUMORS AND "ANTI-IRANIAN PROPAGANDA."
